newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Malta to explain enlargement stance to GAC.
newsitem.headline: Malta to explain enlargement stance to GAC.

text.p: Malta will explain to the General Affairs Council on Monday its new government's position on future relations with the European Union.
The Labour government of Prime Minister Alfred Sant, sworn in on October 29, came to office pledging to withdraw its application for membership.
Diplomats said Malta had not yet done this, although it had effectively frozen its membership bid by saying it will not take part in the structured dialogue with the GAC on Tuesday morning.
Instead, Deputy Prime Minister George Vella would meet EU foreign ministers at 11 a.m. (1000 GMT) on Monday to discuss future ties.
EU officials said they had detected something of a softening in the Maltese stance since the new government took office
They said they believed Malta may want to keep its options open, putting the application on hold rather than withdrawing it altogether.
